description: This file defines a Flutter widget for displaying a menu screen in a restaurant app. It includes UI components such as categories, items, and navigation to item details, utilizing provider for state management and localization.

classes.name: MenuScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the main menu interface with categories and items.

classes.name: _CategorySection
classes.description: A widget displaying a category header and a horizontal list of menu items.

classes.name: _ItemCard
classes.description: A widget for displaying individual menu item cards with image, name, description, and price.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for each of the classes, rendering the UI components.
